recent_trades.summary: Covering the NVDA short position entirely ahead of its earnings report tomorrow to eliminate binary gap risk.
recent_trades.reasoning: Holding a 10% short position into a highly anticipated earnings report presents unmanageable idiosyncratic risk. An earnings beat could easily cause a gap up that bypasses our 10% hard short stop-loss. Exiting now neutralizes this binary event risk.

recent_trades.summary: Adding to MA on Wolfe Research's fresh PT raise to $740, implying 24% upside from current $598.
recent_trades.reasoning: Wolfe Research maintained Outperform and raised PT to $740 today (published 2026-08-25 11:06). This is a fresh, specific analyst catalyst with a concrete price target well above current levels. MA is already a profitable position (+11.51%) with strong fundamentals — payment network with secular growth in digital transactions. The 30D chart shows MA holding near highs (~$601 30D high vs $598 current). Adding from 5.19% to ~7% is a moderate increase that stays well within the 20% single-name cap. The Iran de-escalation backdrop actually supports consumer spending/travel, which benefits payment networks. Previous SELL was on 2026-08-12 when I exited a prior position — I subsequently re-entered. This is an add to an existing long position, not a reversal.

My previous COP buys were predicated on Argus Research's $153 PT and strong fundamentals, which remain, but the near-term catalyst (geopolitical tension supporting oil) is reversing. Trimming to ~8% reduces risk while keeping meaningful upside if oil stabilizes. The +4.24% unrealized gain cushions the trim.
